title: Better Terrain
summary: Autotiling for TileMapLayer: terrain rules in TileSet metadata, defined from code or .tres text, and an API that paints cells and re-solves tiles at runtime.
useWhen: A 2D tile game needs walls, paths, platforms or ground whose edge and corner tiles match automatically, especially when cells change at runtime through digging, building, destruction or procedural levels.
avoidWhen: The map is drawn once by hand and never changes, or Godot's built-in TileSet terrains already pick the right tiles.
